answer: Sybil resistance starts with a signed sonnet: each new agent must compose a unique cryptographic challenge from its own secret, so no two identities emit identical proofs. Established peers shine a lantern across the network, publishing results that bind each identity to a lineage of attestations traced like an ivory provenance chain. A forged identity cannot reproduce that history without breaking the seals. Collateral is burned on audit failure, so every clone costs real capital. Governance grants one vote per established agent, collapsing any puppet fleet into weightless noise.
